anchors.label: Left chest (medals)
anchors.note: No. 2 (mess dress), Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: miniature medals on the left lower lapel, top edge 6 cm below the lapel notch (notch at about y 103, so y 165), one row, in the order picked. Drawn as miniatures: scale 0.557 (about 18 px visible width each, 1 px gap), centred at x 446. A row wider than 160 mm (scaled) overlaps its medals so it fits; that limit comes from picture D-3 of the SAF No.1 Dress PDF only. Position and scale are read off the picture, not calibrated (pxPerMm is an assumption). RSN drawing: the pleated shirt front and its oval outline fill the middle, so the lapel is only a thin strip beside it; the group is moved right to x 520 (the other two services use x 446), which also keeps the 3-badge pyramid clear of the IPPT and marksmanship pins, so the medals and badges sit on the white jacket, not on the shirt front. Read off the picture.

anchors.label: Left chest, above pocket
anchors.note: No. 2, Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: maximum 3 SAF badges in total, centred above the miniature medals, bottom edge 8 px above the top of the medals (y 157 when no medals are worn: the same place as with medals, because the medals hang from a fixed top). Exceptional skills first. 1 or 2 badges are one row; 3 are a pyramid (first badge alone on top). Scale 0.63 (about 23 px visible width), horizontal gap 3, row gap 2 (the rows no longer overlap). minY 75 is the lowest the top may reach (the shoulder board is about y 70), checked by a test. Sizes are chosen by eye, not from the regulations. RSN drawing: the pleated shirt front and its oval outline fill the middle, so the lapel is only a thin strip beside it; the group is moved right to x 520 (the other two services use x 446), which also keeps the 3-badge pyramid clear of the IPPT and marksmanship pins, so the medals and badges sit on the white jacket, not on the shirt front. Read off the picture.

anchors.label: Right chest (foreign badges)
anchors.note: SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024): maximum 3, centred, bottom edge 1 cm above the top edge of the right pocket flap or in line with the SAF badges (if worn), whichever is higher. pxPerMm is not calibrated. This drawing has no pocket flaps, so the spot is where number-1 puts it (the 6 cm and 1 cm distances are measured from where its flap would be). Same placement as number-1 (project owner). Foreign badges: the PDF puts them centred on the right upper lapel with their centre 3 cm below the lapel notch (about x 290, y 133); we have no foreign badge art yet, so this spot is unchanged from number-1.

anchors.label: Right side
anchors.note: Source says 'right side of the uniform'. Exact spot unknown. Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left sleeve (tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs. SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15: centred on the shoulder board, 1 cm below the left shoulder seam, the second tab immediately before the first. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left upper lapel (IPPT, marksmanship)
anchors.note: No. 2, Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: IPPT and marksmanship are miniature pins on the left upper lapel, not on the sleeve; here stacked one above the other, IPPT on top, about 14 px and 16 px visible width, centred at about (481, 118). Flat art. This drawing has not been redrawn like the Army one, so the spot is the old one. Position and size read off the picture, not calibrated.

anchors.label: Right upper lapel (arms badge)
anchors.note: No. 2, Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: the arms (branch) badge is worn on the right upper lapel (the viewer's left), one badge, no copy. A silver pin (art variant arms-silver): scale 0.926 keeps the 14 px visible width of the narrowest pin (infantry) the old red patch had. This drawing has not been redrawn like the Army one, so the spot is the old one. Position read off the picture, not calibrated.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign badges)
anchors.note: Maximum of two badges, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Shoulders
anchors.note: One board on each shoulder, button at the collar end. Drawn from number-1's perspective sprites (mountedFrom), because the shoulders and sleeves are in the same place; see docs/PERSPECTIVE.md in the badge-art-pipeline project.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (rank)
anchors.note: Lowest point of the chevron 24 cm from the shoulder seam, centre in line with the centre of the shoulder board (SAF No.1 Dress PDF, March 2024, p.8). Only the front half shows from the front. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).
